selection: selection-v1 SHA256, one dialog per content cluster before repeats
test_use: single terminal evaluation after development and state freezing; no tuning from test scores

adaptation.limitation: approximate per-attempt gate; no anytime or familywise guarantee

model_selection: Maximum development turn-macro coverage among Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B, each with thinking disabled or bounded at 512 tokens per call; no test results used.

amendments.reason: include an abstract-memory candidate in the shared first-attempt schedule; same cap for L1 and L2

amendments.change: Compare both backbones with thinking disabled and with a 512-token thinking budget per call
amendments.reason: Separate base-model reasoning mode from adaptive search; thinking tokens remain inside the existing total max_tokens and task output budget

amendments.change: Use the first question of each proposal/audit dialog for the preliminary mechanism study; keep complete terminal test dialogs
amendments.reason: Bound adaptation feedback while retaining 4 independent proposal groups and 6 independent audit groups per attempt; broader multi-turn adaptation is a subsequent experiment

amendments.change: Abort study-v3 proposal run and restart study-v4 after lossless AST patch-guard fix
amendments.reason: SQLite rendering can omit unsupported function arguments. Signatures now preserve AST arguments and a patch must serialize to exactly its expected AST. All primary proposal comparisons restart; no audit or terminal test was inspected.

common_first_attempt: Identical first-attempt outputs and scores are reused for L1 and L2; subsequent meta-state differs only through the L2 rule.
equivalent_final_states: Reuse final predictions and scores if solver policy and memory are identical; disclose aliases rather than attributing judge noise to RSI.
hardware: 8B nonthinking GPU1; 8B thinking GPU7; 32B two TP=2 replicas on GPUs2,3 and5,6; GPUs0,4 untouched. All services bound to loopback.
